question: If the curved surface area of a right circular cylinder of height 12 cm is 96 π cm², then its radius is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a cylinder = 2πrh

⇒ 2 × π × r × 12 = 96π

⇒ 24π × r = 96π

⇒ r = 4 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 4 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height of the cylinder (h) = 12 cm

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 96π cm²

**Formula Used:**

CSA of a right circular cylinder = 2πrh

**Calculation:**

⇒ 2 × π × r × 12 = 96π

⇒ 24π × r = 96π

⇒ r = 96π ÷ 24π

⇒ r = 4 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 4 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cylinder

The total surface area encompasses both the curved face and the two flat circular bases. Formula: TSA = 2πr(r + h)

Volume of a Cylinder

The amount of 3D space occupied by a right circular cylinder. Formula: Volume = πr²h

Curved Surface Area of a Cone

For a right circular cone having base radius r and slant height l. Formula: CSA = πrl
